sentences.wiring_vs_shuffle: On two of five seeds, the fly's 166,700-neuron wiring and its degree-preserving shuffle reproduced SuperTruth's Data Trust Index engine equally well: composite error 1.57 vs 1.57 points (difference 0.00, 95% CI -0.67 to +0.66), tier agreement 0.877 vs 0.873.
sentences.wiring_vs_random_and_matched_network: A random graph at the fly's density matched the fly's wiring on tier agreement (0.871 vs 0.877) and came within 0.23 points of it on composite error (1.80 vs 1.57); all three fixed graphs beat a same-size trained network at reproducing the DTI engine (3.56 points, 0.853).
sentences.model_arms_beside_fly: Four models given the DTI paper and 300 of the same records matched the engine's tier on 20% (Claude Opus 5) to 45% (Gemini 3 Flash), at 13 s to 73 s and $0.04 to $0.26 per record. The fly's wiring matched the engine's tier on 84% of the same 300 records, in 16 ms and at $0 marginal cost per record.
sentences.bii: On VIGIL's Behavioral Integrity Index (BII), under the seed policy with empty registries, the fly's wiring reached score error 0.0284 and gate agreement 0.916 on 4,000 synthetic windows; shuffle minus fly -0.0025, 95% CI -0.01 to +0.00.
sentences.model_arms_with_examples: Post-hoc: given the same paper plus 100 engine-scored example records, the four models matched the engine's tier on 54% (GPT-5) to 76% (Claude Opus 5) of the same 300 records; the fly's wiring, 84%.
